DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日の届け出についてのご用件ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした釣り道具の届け出で、持ち主の欄を直したいです。実は店から借りていた物でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既存の遺失届けの所有者情報を直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong itama ang may-ari sa ulat ng nawawalang gamit sa pangingisda. Hiniram pala iyon sa tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais itama ang may-ari sa umiiral na ulat ng pagkawala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付番号と、借りた時の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: May reference number at papeles ng paghiram?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。貸出表に店の名前と管理番号があります。私の道具だと話してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号と貸出表を示し誤った所有説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong numero. May pangalan ng tindahan at management number sa tala ng pahiram. Nasabi kong sarili kong gamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang numero at tala, itama ang maling pagmamay-ari. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 所有者についての情報を担当が確認します。店には紛失したことを伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng kawani ang may-ari. Nasabi sa tindahan ang pagkawala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 伝えました。保険に入っているから、この届け出だけで弁償なしになるのか聞かれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店への連絡済みと保険弁償の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Tinanong nila kung dahil may insurance, sapat itong ulat para wala nang bayad-pinsala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing nasabihan ang tindahan at itanong ang insurance at bayad-pinsala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保険や貸出契約の扱いは、店と保険の担当へご確認ください。こちらでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Insurance at kasunduan sa hiram ay sa tindahan at insurance staff tiyakin. Hindi namin mapagpapasiyahan dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。店には、所有者の情報を直す相談に来たことと、受付番号を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保険は別担当と理解し店への報告内容を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan. Sasabihin kong dumating para itama ang may-ari at ibibigay ang reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawaing hiwalay ang insurance at piliin ang iuulat sa tindahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理番号も用紙へお書きください。道具の特徴を追加する資料として担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Isulat din ang management number. Idaragdag namin sa detalye ng pagkilala ng gamit para sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貸出表の番号を書きました。所有者は店、借りて使っていたのは私という形で、記録を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貸出管理番号を記入し店と借主を分けて訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naisulat ang numero ng pahiram. Gusto kong tindahan ang may-ari at ako ang nanghiram at gumamit sa tala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Isulat ang numero at ibukod ang tindahan at nanghiram sa pagwawasto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類を持って担当席へどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dalhin ang papeles sa kawani. Mag-ingat pauwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便のお受け取りについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa pagtanggap ng sulat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週から十日ほど家を空けます。郵便受けがいっぱいになりそうで、配達を止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長期不在中の郵便保管を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mula sa susunod na linggo, mawawala ako nang mga sampung araw. Baka mapuno ang kahon, kaya nais ipatigil ang hatid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pagtatabi ng sulat sa mahabang pagkawala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在中の保管について受付担当が確認します。不在の期間はいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin ng tanggapan ang pagtatabi. Kailan ang simula ng pagkawala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月曜から翌週の水曜までです。帰宅するのは水曜の夜です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在期間と帰宅時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lunes hanggang Miyerkules ng kasunod na linggo. Miyerkules ng gabi ang uwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang panahon at oras ng pag-uwi. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご住所と、本人確認の書類をご用意いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maihahanda ang address at katibayan ng pagkakakilanlan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所はこちらです。免許証を持ってきました。木曜からまた配達してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所本人確認書類と再開希望日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Itong address. Dala ang lisensiya. Huwebes ko gustong ituloy ang hatid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang address, pagkakakilanlan, at gustong pagpapatuloy. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期間の書き方を担当がご案内します。ご家族の郵便もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang pagsulat ng panahon. May sulat din ng pamilya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人暮らしです。宅配便も全部ここで止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 世帯状況を答え宅配便も対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mag-isa ako. Maaari bang lahat ng courier package ay pigilin dito rin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang sambahayan at itanong kung kasama ang courier. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 他社の配達は別にご相談ください。こちらで扱う郵便の範囲も担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay na ikonsulta ang ibang kompanya. Ipapaliwanag din ang saklaw ng sulat dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この住所への郵便の保管を申し込みます。他社の荷物は配送会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 郵便保管を申し込み他社への連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Mag-aaplay akong itabi ang sulat sa address na ito. Kokontakin ang courier para sa ibang pakete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mag-apply ng pagtatabi at piliing kontakin ang ibang kompanya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの受付へどうぞ。ご旅行、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito sa pagtanggap. Mag-ingat sa biyahe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードについてのお問い合わせですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布を取られたかもしれません。銀行のカードをすぐ止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 盗難の疑いと緊急停止を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Baka ninakaw ang pitaka ko. Nais kong pigilin agad ang bank card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang posibleng pagnanakaw at agarang pag-block. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止担当へつなぎます。カードの種類とお名前をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ikokonekta sa pang-block. Pakisabi ang uri at pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: キャッシュカードです。名義は山田健です。番号は財布の中で分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード種類名義と番号不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Cash card. Ken Yamada ang pangalan. Nasa pitaka ang numero kaya hindi ko alam.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ilarawan ang card, pangalan, at hindi alam na numero. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号不明でもそのまま担当へお伝えください。登録した電話はお使いになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin ding hindi alam ang numero. Magagamit ang rehistradong telepono?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この携帯です。さっき残高を見たら、知らない引き出しがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録電話の利用と不明な出金を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo, itong mobile. Nang tingnan ang balanse kanina, may withdrawal na hindi ko kilala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang rehistradong telepono at di-kilalang withdrawal. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その取引の時刻と金額も担当へ伝えましょう。通帳はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabihin din ang oras at halaga sa kawani. May passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家にあります。今は停止を先にお願いして、取引の画面を保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止を優先し取引記録を残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nasa bahay. Block muna ang pakiusap ngayon, at ise-save ang screen ng transaksiyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unahin ang block at itabi ang rekord. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。再発行については停止の確認後に別途ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan. Hiwalay ang muling pag-isyu matapos matiyak ang block.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず停止と知らない引き出しの相談をお願いします。再発行はその後に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止と出金相談を依頼し再発行を後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Block at konsultasyon sa di-kilalang withdrawal muna. Pagkatapos ko itatanong ang bagong card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng block at withdrawal consultation bago muling pag-isyu. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この電話を担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ikokonekta ang tawag sa kawani. Paalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品についてでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った米を開けたら、小さな虫がいました。残りは袋に入れたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開封した米の異常と残品を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pagbukas ng bigas na binili kahapon, may maliliit na insekto. Nasa supot pa ang natitira.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang problema sa binuksang bigas at natitirang produkto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご不便をおかけしました。購入のレシートはありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。五キロの袋で、今朝初めて開けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入証明と開封時点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito. Limang kilo, unang binuksan ngayong umaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang patunay ng pagbili at oras ng pagbukas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品担当が現物と袋の表示を確認します。お米はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng produkto ang aktuwal at label ng supot. Dala ang bigas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 重いので今日は袋の写真だけです。持ってくるまで、口を閉じて置いておけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物未持参を伝え保管方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mabigat kaya larawan lang ngayon. Isasara at itatabi lang muna bago dalhin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang aktuwal at itanong ang pag-iimbak. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身が出ないようにし、担当から扱い方をご案内します。連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Huwag hayaang lumabas ang laman; ipapaliwanag ang paghawak. Kontak po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号です。家には同じ米がもう一袋あるので、そちらの番号も写真に撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先と別の未開封袋を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong numero. May isa pang parehong bigas sa bahay, kukunan din ang numero nito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kontak at isa pang hindi nabuksang supot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 製造番号が読める写真をお願いします。返金か交換かは確認後にご相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Larawang nababasa ang production number. Refund o palit ay pag-usapan matapos tingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二袋の番号を送って、現物を持参する日時を担当と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋の番号提出と現物持参の調整を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan. Ipapadala ang numero ng dalawang supot at itatakda sa kawani kailan dadalhin ang aktuwal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang dalawang numero at pag-ayos ng pagdadala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa sa kawani. Salamat sa pagpunta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海側の遊歩道をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gagamit po ng daang malapit sa dagat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 岬の方まで歩きたいです。この細い道は帰りも通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低い海沿い道の帰路利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong lumakad sa tangway. Madadaanan din itong makitid na daan pabalik?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pabalik sa mababang daang baybayin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 海沿いの低い部分は、今日は午後に閉鎖します。今から往復されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Isasara ang mababang baybayin mamayang hapon. Pabalik-balik mula ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼を食べてから戻る予定です。それだと閉鎖に間に合わないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰る時間と閉鎖の問題を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Babalik matapos tanghalian. Hindi na aabot bago pagsara kung ganoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang oras ng balik at problema sa pagsara. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上の遊歩道なら帰りも通れます。岬まで少し遠回りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ang mataas na daan ay bukas din pabalik. Medyo iikot patungo sa tangway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の道には、途中で腰を下ろせる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上の道の休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May mauupuan sa mataas na daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pahingahan sa mataas na daan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展望広場にベンチがあります。そこから岬までは十分ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: May bangko sa tanawang plaza. Sampung minuto ang tangway mula roon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では低い道は使わず、上の道で広場までにします。風は強いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い経路に変更し風を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi na mababa; hanggang plaza lang sa mataas. Malakas ang hangin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Lumipat sa maikling ruta at itanong ang hangin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広場は風を受けやすいです。手前の東屋なら屋根と壁があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Mahanging lugar ang plaza. May bubong at dingding ang kubol bago roon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東屋で休んで、風が強ければそこから戻ります。道の入口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東屋を折返し候補にして入口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa kubol magpapahinga at doon babalik kung malakas. Pakituro ang pasukan ng daan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gawing posibleng balikan ang kubol at itanong ang pasukan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 管理棟の裏から続いています。どうぞよい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Mula sa likod ng gusali ng pamamahala. Magandang paglalakad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日出発して日曜に帰ります。往復で買いたいのですが、帰りの日付も指定しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復券の帰りの日付指定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bukas aalis at Linggo babalik. Round trip sana; pipiliin din ang petsa ng balik?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang takdang balik sa round trip. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定する券と、期間内に使う券があります。帰りの列車は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May takdang tiket at may sa loob ng panahon. Napili na ang tren ng balik?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜の夕方に帰りたいですが、時刻はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの日と時刻未定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Linggo ng hapon ang gusto pero wala pang oras.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang araw at hindi pa takdang oras. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの座席を指定しなければ、こちらの往復券が候補です。区間はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung walang reserbang upuan sa balik, opsiyon itong round trip. Itong ruta?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、山里駅までです。有効期間の最後は何曜日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間と有効期間の最終日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo, hanggang Yamazato. Anong araw ang huling bisa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang ruta at huling araw ng bisa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この券では日曜までです。月曜に延びる可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hanggang Linggo ito. Posibleng umabot ng Lunes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。帰りは普通列車にして、日曜中に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日曜の普通列車利用を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi. Lokal ang balik, gagamitin sa loob ng Linggo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Piliin ang lokal sa Linggo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この区間の往復券ですね。帰りの分は切り離して保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Round trip nitong ruta. Hiwalayin at itabi ang pabalik.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行きと帰りを分けて財布に入れます。この往復券を一人分ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復券一人分を購入し分けて保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hiwalay na ilalagay sa pitaka ang papunta at pabalik. Isang tao po nitong round trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bumili ng pang-isang tao at itabi nang hiwalay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発行しました。よいご旅行を。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてご用件を伺います。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の税金の通知が来ました。でも、この番号の車はもう売っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 売却済みの車への税通知を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: May abiso ng buwis ng kotse. Pero naibenta ko na ang kotse sa numerong ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang buwis ng naibentang kotse. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知と、売却した時の書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May abiso at papeles ng bentahan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知はあります。売却の控えは家ですが、二月に店へ渡しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の持参と売却時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: May abiso. Nasa bahay ang kopya, pero Pebrero naibigay sa tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang abiso at panahon ng bentahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 税の担当が登録状況と日付を確認します。納期限はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ng buwis ang rehistro at mga petsa. Kailan ang takdang bayad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月末です。事情を調べている間も、払う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限と照会中の支払い扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Katapusan ng buwan. Kailangan pa ring magbayad habang sinisiyasat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang takda at bayad habang sinisiyasat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いの扱いは担当が説明しますので、期限も一緒にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng kawani ang bayad; sabihin din ang takda.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。売った店の名前と電話番号も控えて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売却先の情報も用意すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan. Itatala at dadalhin ko rin ang pangalan at telepono ng tindahang binentahan ko ng kotse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing ihahanda rin ang impormasyon ng bumili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は通知を見せて相談を始められます。担当の窓口は奥です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaari nang simulan ngayon sa abiso. Nasa loob ang counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日まず期限の扱いを相談して、売却書類は必要な部分を聞いてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日期限を相談し追加資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Takda muna ngayon, at itatanong kung anong bahagi ng bentahan ang kailangan bago dalhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang takda ngayon at tiyakin ang dagdag na papeles. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの順番札をお取りください。失礼いたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紹介状がありますが、封を開けていなくて、どの科か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状があり診療科が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. May referral, pero hindi pa bukas ang sobre at hindi alam ang departamento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing may referral ngunit hindi alam ang departamento. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先を拝見できますか。予約はお取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaari bang makita ang pinatutunguhan ng sobre? May appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒です。予約はなく、紹介した先生に午前中に来るよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約なしと紹介元の指示を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong sobre. Wala; sabi ng nag-refer na doktor, umaga pumunta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na walang appointment at utos ng doktor na nag-refer. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外来担当に受付の可否を確認します。今気になる症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin sa outpatient kung matatanggap. May sintomas na nakakabahala ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日より息切れが強くなっています。入口から歩くのもつらかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 息切れ悪化と歩行困難を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mas hingal kaysa kahapon. Mahirap kahit maglakad mula pasukan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat ang lumalang hingal at hirap maglakad. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 息切れの様子を確認します。ここにお掛けください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。立って並ばず、この椅子で待っていていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座ったまま待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Maaari bang sa upuan maghintay, hindi nakatayong pumila?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang nakaupong paghihintay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、座ったままで結構です。医師へ症状を伝えるので、お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, manatiling upo. Sasabihin sa doktor ang sintomas, pangalan po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 佐藤洋子です。紹介状はお渡しします。症状のことを先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名と紹介状を渡し症状相談を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yoko Sato. Ibibigay ang referral. Sintomas muna ang gusto kong ikonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang pangalan at referral at unahin ang sintomas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ここでお加減を確認し、医師へ引き継ぎます。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin dito ang pakiramdam at ipapasa sa doktor. Magpagaling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われた免許証をお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駐車場の係の人に拾ったことを話したら、持ち主らしい人が私のところへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得後に持ち主を名乗る人が現れたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Nang sabihin ko sa kawani ng paradahan, may tila may-ari na lumapit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing may nagpakilalang may-ari matapos mapulot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 免許証は、その方に渡したのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 渡していません。名前は同じでしたが、写真と顔が違うように見えたので、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未返却と写真の違和感を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Pareho ang pangalan, pero parang iba ang mukha sa larawan kaya dinala rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang hindi pagbabalik at kakaibang larawan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで持ち主を確認します。その方から連絡先を聞かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kami ang titiyak sa may-ari. Hiningi ang kontak?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号だけ聞かれましたが、教えていません。「兄の免許証だ」と言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡先未提供と兄の物との説明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Telepono lang, pero hindi ko ibinigay. Sabi, lisensiya ng kuya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat ang hindi pagbibigay ng kontak at sabi ng pag-aari ng kuya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのお話も記録します。拾った場所へ戻って手渡す約束はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatala rin. Nangakong bumalik sa lugar para ibigay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 約束していません。ただ、係の人に警察へ届けると伝えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却約束なしと駐車場への届け先連絡を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi nangako. Pero nais sabihin sa kawani na sa pulis ko dadalhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang pangako at itanong ang pagsabi ng destinasyon sa paradahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 免許証はこちらでお預かりします。係の方には届け先だけ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dito itatabi ang lisensiya. Destinasyon lang ang sabihin sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。本人確認と返却はお任せします。駐車場には、この警察署へ届けたと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認を警察へ任せ施設に届け先を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan. Sa inyo ang pagkilala at pagbabalik. Sasabihin kong dito sa himpilan ibinigay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipaubaya sa pulis ang pagkilala at ipaalam sa pasilidad ang pinagdalhan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。お届けありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居のお届けについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa abiso ng paglipat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転送を申し込んだのに、旧姓で届く郵便が前の家に残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧姓宛ての郵便が転送されなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nag-apply ng forwarding, pero naiwan sa lumang bahay ang sulat sa dating apelyido.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi naipasa ang sulat sa lumang apelyido. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込みに書いたお名前は、現在のお名前だけですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、今の名字だけです。旧姓で届くものも転送してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届出名義と旧姓分の希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo, kasalukuyang apelyido lang. Ipapasa rin sana ang luma.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pangalan sa aplikasyon at hiling para sa lumang apelyido. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 旧姓の郵便を扱えるか、受付担当が申込内容を確認します。旧住所の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ng pagtanggap ang aplikasyon para sa lumang apelyido. May kopya ng lumang address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この控えがあります。前の家に住む人が、郵便を渡してくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所控えと受領の経緯を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito. Ibinigay ng nakatira sa dating bahay ang sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang lumang address at kuwento ng pagtanggap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いた封筒もあれば、宛名の確認に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Makakatulong din ang mga sobre sa pagtiyak ng pangalan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二通持ってきました。送り主にも新しい住所と名字を知らせた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を提示し送り主への変更通知を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawa ang dala. Dapat ding sabihin sa nagpadala ang bagong address at apelyido, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang sobre at isaalang-alang ang abiso sa nagpadala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今後の発送先を変更してもらうと確実です。こちらの受付番号もお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, mas tiyak kung palitan ang susunod na padadalhan. Ibigay rin itong reference number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えと封筒を担当に見せて、旧姓分の扱いを相談します。送り主には今日連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当への資料提示と発送元連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapakita ang kopya at sobre at ikokonsulta ang lumang apelyido. Ngayon kokontakin ang nagpadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang pagpakita ng papeles at pakikipag-ugnayan sa nagpadala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当はこちらです。ご来局ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito ang kawani. Salamat sa pagpunta sa post office.
